newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: No more S.Africans diagnosed with Ebola.
newsitem.headline: No more S.Africans diagnosed with Ebola.

text.p: Six days after a nurse was diagnosed as the first South African with the deadly Ebola virus, health officials said on Friday none of the 300 other people they had been monitoring had contracted the disease yet.

Marilyn Lahana, a 46-year-old mother of two who nursed a Gabon doctor and contracted Ebola from him, was still critically ill with multiple organ dysfunction and was dependent on life support systems.

"There is a comprehensive system in place to monitor more than 300 people who are classified as contacts or people who have been exposed to the risk of contracting Ebola fever by contact with the body fluids of one of the two patients," health officials said in a statement.
They said the list of "contacts" included even those who had a minimal risk of contracting the disease.
